description: This file defines an interface 'ConnectivityEvent' in Java, which models events related to connectivity, specifically for connection-related activities. It includes constants, method signatures, and nested classes for JSON field definitions, serving as a base for various connectivity event implementations.

classes.name: ConnectivityEvent
classes.description: An interface for all connection-related events within the system, providing methods to access connection identifiers, resource paths, and metadata, along with constants defining JSON fields related to connectivity events.

methods.name: getConnectionId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the modified connection as a String (deprecated, use getConnectionEntityId instead).

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the ConnectionId object representing the identity of the connection.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Overrides to return the connection entity ID.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the resource path for this event, defaulting to an empty JSON pointer.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException because connectivity events do not have revisions.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException because connectivity events do not support setting revisions.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers; implementation to be provided by concrete classes.
